rule: No candidate enters the app until every person has a reviewed year-specific claim, independent sources, relationship language, rights review, and blind-test record.

candidates.hook: A sculptor dies three days after an astronomer is born.
candidates.risk: Same-year relay; never imply contact.

candidates.hook: A new stage world and a newly observed sky take shape in the same year.
candidates.risk: The Tempest dating is usually 1610–1611; do not force a single year without editorial review.

candidates.hook: Frankenstein enters print in the year Douglass is born into slavery.
candidates.risk: Douglass did not know his exact birth date; preserve uncertainty.

candidates.hook: An algorithmic note and a national abolitionist lecture campaign share a year.
candidates.risk: Do not call Lovelace the sole inventor of programming; verify Douglass campaign dates.

candidates.hook: A published testimony against slavery appears while Darwin is privately developing a theory of species change.
candidates.risk: Private work is harder to summarize accurately than a publication event.

candidates.hook: On the Origin of Species and A Tale of Two Cities reach readers in one year.
candidates.risk: Two publications are parallel, not causally connected.

candidates.hook: A battlefield address and a painting that would challenge the Paris Salon are made in one year.
candidates.risk: Olympia was painted in 1863 but exhibited in 1865; say which event is meant.

candidates.hook: The first periodic table appears in the year Gandhi is born.
candidates.risk: Birth-versus-work relay; avoid implying equal historical domains or value.

candidates.hook: The Eiffel Tower opens while van Gogh paints The Starry Night.
candidates.risk: The works were not responses to one another.

candidates.hook: Relativity papers and a scandal of non-natural color arrive in one year.
candidates.risk: Annus mirabilis contains several papers; name the exact claim.

candidates.hook: The moving assembly line and The Rite of Spring reshape repetition in industry and music.
candidates.risk: The shared idea of repetition is editorial interpretation, not documented influence.

candidates.hook: Fountain is submitted in the year Ella Fitzgerald is born.
candidates.risk: Fountain's surviving object is a replica; distinguish submission history from object date.

candidates.hook: Ulysses is published while Carter's team uncovers Tutankhamun's tomb.
candidates.risk: Credit the Egyptian excavation team rather than presenting a lone-discoverer myth.

candidates.hook: A solo Atlantic crossing and the uncertainty principle change two kinds of distance.
candidates.risk: The shared 'distance' framing is metaphor, not scientific relation.

candidates.hook: Three lives later filed into different historical chapters begin in one year.
candidates.risk: A shared birth year alone may be surprising but lacks a year-event beyond birth.

candidates.hook: The Waves reaches readers while Einstein works at Caltech.
candidates.risk: Verify the exact Caltech residence dates and avoid vague 'rethinking the universe' copy.

candidates.hook: Guernica is painted in the year Earhart disappears over the Pacific.
candidates.risk: Treat disappearance with care; do not turn tragedy into spectacle.

candidates.hook: A hidden diary's author dies while the first atomic weapon is completed and used.
candidates.risk: High trauma and atrocity risk; may be unsuitable for surprise-led presentation.

candidates.hook: Einstein dies in the year Jobs is born.
candidates.risk: A birth/death relay must not imply intellectual succession.

candidates.hook: A civil-rights address and a presidential assassination mark the same year.
candidates.risk: Do not package assassination as entertainment; contextual review required.

candidates.hook: Humans reach the Moon while Hopper is helping standardize business programming languages.
candidates.risk: Hopper's 1969-specific contribution must be verified; do not use a career summary.

candidates.hook: One transformative musical life ends as another begins.
candidates.risk: Birth/death relay only; avoid claiming a direct musical lineage.

candidates.hook: The Web is proposed while a grassroots environmental movement is expanding civic networks in Kenya.
candidates.risk: 'Networks' is an editorial metaphor; exact 1989 Maathai claim required.

candidates.hook: Mandela walks free while the first Web server and browser are built.
candidates.risk: Political liberation and technical invention must not be presented as equivalent events.
